label: Shedu system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Shedu locus encoding a single-protein immune nuclease whose sensor domain architecture regulates an antiphage nuclease core.
observations: Shedu branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual sduA genes, SduA or DUF4263-domain proteins, individual Shedu N-terminal sensor-domain classes, PD-(D/E)XK nuclease activity, DNA-end nicking or degradation subactivities, source database rows naming one Shedu locus or domain, phage escape strategies, and other antiphage systems such as BREX, DISARM, CBASS, Gabija, Hachiman, Thoeris, Zorya, phosphorothioate defense, CRISPR-Cas, and abortive infection families.
